full: Hey there! I’m Angel Marie, and I wanted to share a bit about myself now that I’ve settled into my foster home. Looking for a quirky girl? Winning! I love fast walks sprinkled with sniff stops and when we get home I enjoy celebratory play bows and spins because it just felt so good to get out in the fresh air and stretch my fluffy legs. During the day I can often be found napping on my back with all four legs in the air because I'm a gal who knows the art of relaxation. Car rides are a piece of cake and if you’re going somewhere – errands, to the park, coffee drive thru, whatever – then I want to go with you. Nail clippings are a cinch and I enjoy being brushed except am a little particular about my tail. Who isn’t? When new humans come over, I greet them with a gently wagging tail, walk right up to my new friend and wait for pets, but am not pushy. After a good meal, I like to give myself a hearty chin rub on my bed (or maybe yours?!? Ha!) and then flip over on my back and wiggle around in contentment. I love to sleep on the bed at night with my person and don’t hog the bed (much). Don’t be fooled by my age. Although technically a senior, I have a perfect balance of hanging out and GO energy. Want to play? Me, too! Want to hang out and watch TV or take a nap? Me, too! My foster mom thinks I’m like Mary Poppins – practically perfect in every way.

full: Bandit sounds like the name of a troublemaker, right? But the truth is....this boy might be the worst bandit in history — because the only thing he’s guilty of is loving too hard. Bandit is nothing but sweetness, love, and joyful energy wrapped up in one very handsome shepherd mix. He’s a fun-loving boy who absolutely thrives on friendship — especially with his best buddy, Smokey. The two of them spend their days playing, exploring, and reminding each other that life can still be full of joy. Watching them together is the kind of thing that just makes you smile. Before rescue, Bandit and Smokey went through something no dog should have to experience. After being dumped, they were chased away with gunshots meant to scare them off. Thankfully, their story didn’t end there. They were rescued by Skippy Skippins Rescue, where they are now safe, loved, and absolutely thriving. Bandit is a strikingly handsome boy with a playful spirit and a heart that just wants to belong. He would do wonderfully in a home with another dog companion and a family who enjoys an active lifestyle and plenty of playtime. Despite the name, this Bandit isn’t here to steal anything....he’s just here to steal your heart.

full: Before being brought to the shelter, Elsa had been poorly socialized to humans. During her foster stay, she has been doted on 24/7, she is the princess of the house, and is still learning to trust sudden movements and accepting human affection especially from unfamiliar ones. She has formed a close connection with one person in the house and will likely have a preferred person once adopted. She takes lots of cues from the other dogs on how to behave and what is expected- such as eating in her kennel and when to go outside and come back inside. While she is not big into group-play right now, she does enjoy relaxing while chewing her stuffies and she is incredibly fond of cuddles. She is potty-trained and a very good girl in her kennel. Her favorite places around the house are the bed or couch and can be reliably found on the bed when it’s time to kennel-up. Elsa is excellent with small animals and children, paying them no mind and leaving them to their business, and will need a companion dog in the home she is adopted into. Her future adopter can look forward to bonding with her while teaching her confidence and how to trust.

full: . Hi! I'm Felicity , and I am about as perfect a pyr as possible, if I do say so myself. I have never met a person I don't love upon sight, and I can't understand when they don't stop to meet me! I love to look pretty and wear my fancy harnesses, bandanas, or anything else to show off my gorgeous self. I know I'm mixed with some other breed (maybe a golden retriever?), and my behavior shows it. I am the happiest, silliest girl, and I just want to be loved on all day long. I really don't like to be alone, so I need someone who can stay home with me a lot or take me to work with them. I know I'm a little older than you might be thinking, but I don't act my age even a little bit. I love to run around in my backyard and make sure all those scary things like leaves falling and birds flying stay out of my space. I hop in and out of the car and love to play with my dog and cat friends. Snuggling up with them - and you - are one of my favorite things in the whole wide world. I would be happy to live in a house with other dogs, cats, and even kids, but the most important thing to me is to be with you - I don't need to have a lot of friends - just you would be just fine for me! I liked being a city dog at my last house, but I also have fun in my backyard. I'm a little loud, so apartments might be tough for your neighbors unless you're pretty soundproofed. Please please please adopt me! I just want to love you every minute of every day!

full: Hi. I’m Feliz. I am a professional zoomie athlete, part-time wrestling champion (my brother can confirm), and full-time Lover of Life. I LOVE to play — especially with my brother and my mom. They’re my favorite teammates. But don’t worry… I am absolutely accepting applications for new best friends. I’m a friend to everyone I meet. No strangers. Just future fans. I have energy. Like… capital E Energy. I am young, I am fun, and I am ready to go. Hikes? Let’s do it. Training sessions? I’m listening (mostly). Toys? Yes. All of them. Since I’m a growing GSD boy, I’m going to need someone who’s ready to teach me all the cool, important life skills. I’m smart — like, really smart — so if you put the time into me, I promise I’ll turn into the most impressive, loyal sidekick you’ve ever had. In the meantime, I come fully stocked with unlimited kisses and daily joy delivery. Bad day? I’ll fix it. Need a smile? I’m already on it. I’m loving. I’m rambunctious. I’m ready. Pick me, and I promise to grow up to be your very best boy. (But I’m going to stay a little silly. Just so you know.)

full: Meet Heath , a wonderfully sweet "badger boy" with a beautiful, slightly curly coat who is looking for his perfect forever family! As part of our "Sweet Treat" litter born right here in our rescue care, Heath has been raised with hands-on love from the very beginning, making him remarkably calm, smart, and responsive to human affection. He is a gentle soul who is perhaps a bit more thoughtful and reserved than his energetic littermates, making him an absolute dream for someone who loves a balanced pup. Heath truly adores his cuddle time and loves a good play session, but he is equally happy to slow down, relax, and contentedly chew on a nice stick. If you are looking for a loving, steady companion with fantastic genetics and a sweet disposition, Heath is ready to bring a lifetime of devotion to your home. Adoption fee: $450 (Adoption fee includes spay or neuter, distemper/parvo vaccines, flea preventative, deworming, and health certificate for travel). Adopters pay the cost of transport services outside of Texas area. Transport costs depend on location and company used. Northeast transport fee is $200. The Northwest and Midwest transport fees range from $225-$350, The Southeast transport fees range from $250-$350. Fill out an application today! https://gprs.rescuegroups.org/ . full: If your checklist includes finding a furry adventure buddy with a love for people and all things outdoorsy, Howie is your guy. Born around June 2017, Howie’s ideal match would be an active owner who loves exploring as much as he does. While he’s perfectly content to spend the day lounging on the back porch or catching up on his beauty sleep, Howie also has bursts of playful energy that will remind you just how fun life can be! Walks are his favorite, and while he may get a bit excited at the sight of other dogs, a confident owner with a firm grip will make those outings a breeze. Handsome, intelligent, and as sweet as they come, Howie is a social guy who loves making new friends. Once you’ve earned his trust, he’s the most loyal companion you could hope for. While he’s not the type to crawl into your lap for a cuddle, he’ll happily lay by your feet while you work, offering quiet support and the occasional side-eye if you’re not sharing snacks. Howie’s ideal family would be an experienced and active one, without cats, small dogs, or young children—teenagers are more his speed! He’d thrive with a large lady dog companion, or as the solo star of the show with an owner who knows their way around big, lovable pups. This boy is bursting with love and loyalty, just waiting for the right person to share it with—preferably someone with treats and hiking boots.

name: Izzy
desc: ** Tune in to our Facebook page (Great Pyrenees Rescue Society - GPRS) every Sunday at 3pm CT to see our dogs LIVE! You can also find previous episodes on our YouTube channel (@gprspyrs). If you would like a specific dog to be featured on our show, p...
full: Meet Izzy, a beautiful Pyrenees girl with a sweetness level that should probably come with a warning label. Born around May 2020, Izzy has main-character energy and a heart so big it barely fits in her adorable Pyr body. Izzy has had professional obedience training (yep, she’s educated), so she walks like she’s auditioning for a fancy dog food commercial, and she generally carries herself like she knows she’s a catch--because she is. Socially, Izzy is a friendly, happy pup who gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a home with a big, playful dog buddy—preferably a fellow large goofball who’s down for backyard zoomies, toy debates, and dramatic synchronized couch flops. She may need a slow, thoughtful introduction to dominant female dogs (Izzy enjoys good vibes and respectful friendships), but once everyone’s politely introduced, she’s all about being part of the pack. Cats aren’t a dealbreaker either; with proper intros, she can coexist just fine (she’s classy like that). At home, Izzy is wonderfully devoted and protective of her people, which means surprise visitors aren’t her favorite plot twist — she prefers to be introduced first. Give her that proper hello, and she’ll switch instantly into full love-bug mode, handing out affection like she’s working a booth at a friendship fair. She’d be happiest with older kiddos since little ones are a bit outside her current life experience, and she'd appreciate a calmer, more predictable household environment. If you’re looking for a beautiful, loyal, sweet-as-can-be sidekick, Izzy is ready to bring a little playful sparkle right into your life.

full: Meet Kitty, the fluffy bundle of fun ready to steal your heart! This irresistibly sweet girl was born in January 2022 and is as lively as they come. With her fluffy coat and boundless energy, Kitty is a true bullet of happiness! Kitty's favorite pastime? Playing fetch and searching for sticks! As an Aussie Sheppy mix, she embodies the intelligence and activity levels typical of her breeds, and she thrives on plenty of physical exercise and mental stimulation. Training sessions are not just fun for Kitty; they're a chance for her to soak up new skills and knowledge. This energetic pup would thrive with a male playmate to keep her company and entertain her with games and adventures. Kitty also enjoys older kids and would be an ideal companion for families. Kitty is spayed, up to date on vaccines, microchipped, and a pro at both crate and house training. And don't let her fluffy exterior fool you—Kitty may look heavy, but the vet assures us she's just a floofy ball of love. If you're ready to add a playful and affectionate companion to your family, don't miss out on the chance to make this charming girl a part of your forever home!

full: Looking for a gentle, active and deeply affectionate companion to complete your family? Meet Ladybird , a sweet, petite girl who is ready to bring a whole lot of love into her forever home! Ladybird is the ultimate family dog. She wants nothing more than to be included in whatever her humans are doing, whether that is hanging out in the living room or going for a neighborhood stroll. Ladybird is crate trained, great on a leash! She is a dream to walk and doesn't pull unless she sees a squirrel. Zero resource guarding and completely non-reactive to other dogs when out on her walks. Ladybird is an easygoing girl, but she has a couple of specific. She requires a home with a secure, 6-foot fenced yard to explore safely. Ladybird thrives with an active canine company! She requires at least one large playful dog in her new home to act as her companion and playmate. Unlike many guardian breeds, Ladybird is not a big barker , making her a wonderful addition.

This charming boy frequently throws the famous "Pyr Paw" to ask for extra pets and affection. He loves playing with other dogs, chewing on bones, and splitting his relaxation time between the couch and his outdoor dog bed. Lucas adapts quickly to household routines, uses the dog door with ease, and will alert you to strangers without barking excessively. He tolerates grooming well, and his low-maintenance coat is easy to keep looking its best, making him a wonderful companion for a lucky person or family.

desc: Meet Maddox, a tall, lanky, goofy boy who just seems happy all the time. He’s playful, full of energy, and honestly just a fun dog to be around. He’s been friendly with every person and dog he’s met so far, and he loves attention &m...
full: Meet Maddox, a tall, lanky, goofy boy who just seems happy all the time. He’s playful, full of energy, and honestly just a fun dog to be around. He’s been friendly with every person and dog he’s met so far, and he loves attention — if you’re willing to pet him, he’s more than willing to stick close and soak it all up. Maddox is very tall and very bouncy, and when he first greets you, he tends to go in for hugs. So he’ll do best with people who don’t mind a big, enthusiastic hello and can help him work on keeping all four paws on the ground. Maddox loves walks, playtime, and being around other dogs, and he’ll need an active home that’s ready to keep up with him. Because Maddox stays on the move, he’s on the thinner side and could use some extra groceries in his future. This boy would thrive with a family who’s happy to keep him busy and keep the treats coming. Think active home, fun schedule, and a playful dog sibling who can match his energy. Maddox also has some serious hops, so a secure fence will be key for him as well. The rescue has been Maddox’s only home since the day he was born, so he’ll need a little patience and understanding as he learns what real “forever home” life feels like. But he’s sweet, friendly, and has a heart that’s somehow even bigger than his legs. If you’re looking for a sweet, social, playful buddy who will keep you laughing and feeling very loved, Maddox could be your guy.

full: Meet Madison, a stunning girl who is looking for a patient, understanding forever home! While she can be fearful of new people and loud noises, she thrives under the care of someone experienced with fear-reactive dogs who will allow her to blossom at her own pace. Once she knows she is safe, her silly, playful side shines through, and she turns into a major cuddle bug who loves to lean in for hugs. She absolutely loves spending time outside soaking up the sun, watching the world go by, or playfully chasing her foster siblings. Madison considers the crate a cozy, safe sanctuary. She is a social girl who relies on a canine companion for confidence and requires a home with a large, playful brother to keep her company—no only-dog households for this sweet girl! If you have the experience to guide a sensitive girl and a big, friendly male dog ready to welcome a new best friend, Madison is a sweet soul with a beautifully soft coat, big expressive eyes, and a wonderfully polite demeanor on the leash.

full: Marshmallow is a gentle, people-pleasing soul who never gets into trouble, eats well, and doesn't chew on things. While she is initially shy and can be scared of new people—especially men—she is incredibly sweet once she builds trust. Once she knows you, she loves to ask for affection, put her head in your lap, and nap right on you. She is great with kids and other dogs, though her compatibility with cats is currently unknown. Marshmallow does wonderfully in her crate, finding a lot of comfort and safety in having her own space, but she also loves her occasional morning zoomies and makes a funny, adorable snort when she gets excited. Because of her sensitive nature, Marshmallow is looking for a patient, low-stress forever home where she can bloom at her own pace. Having secure access to a yard is very important for her setup. If you are ready to give this beautiful girl the calm environment she needs, she will reward you with endless love and loyalty!

full: Miss Priss is one of those dogs who makes you smile just by looking at her. She’s a beautiful brindle Boxer mix, tall and leggy, and once she decides you’re her person, she is ALL about the hugs and kisses. She can be a little shy when she first meets new people, but she warms up quickly with a calm approach and a little patience. After that, she’s sweet, affectionate, and very happy to be close to you. She does have a higher energy level, so she’ll do best with an active family and ideally an active dog buddy who’s down for some daily shenanigans. And did we mention she’s smart? Miss Priss is the type who figures things out fast—which is adorable until you realize she’s also a talented jumper, so she’ll need a securely fenced yard and a home that appreciates an athletic superstar. Miss Priss has been at the rescue since the day she was born, so this is the only home life she’s known. Because of that, she’s going to need a family that understands she may need a little time to settle in and feel comfortable. But if you’re willing to go slow and let her blossom at her own pace, you’ll get the sweetest payoff—a loyal, affectionate best friend who gives out kisses like they’re going out of style, and who has an endless supply of love to give.

full: Scout: A name usually given to the one leading the adventure.....which feels fitting, because Scout is always on a mission. What mission, you ask? Snuggles. Scout loves snuggles. Desperately. Passionately. With his whole entire heart. The only small issue is....he doesn’t always slow down long enough to actually receive them. One minute he’s zooming over to you like “YES HELLO I WOULD LIKE AFFECTION PLEASE” and the next minute he remembers something extremely important across the room and suddenly he’s off on a brand new investigation. But make no mistake.....the snuggle mission remains ongoing. We’re honestly not sure what breeds make up Scout’s DNA, but whatever the mix is, it created a seriously striking dog. Scout is one of those dogs people stop and do a double-take at. The kind of handsome that makes you say, “Whoa.....that is a good-looking dog.” Photos don’t quite capture it — he’s even more impressive in person. Underneath all that model-level handsomeness, though, is just a goofy, affectionate boy who loves people and wants to be near them.....even if his enthusiasm sometimes results in a few extra wiggles along the way. Scout is the perfect combination of: • lovable goofball • professional curiosity investigator • extremely handsome mystery mix • and very determined future snuggle champion He just needs someone willing to laugh at his antics, appreciate his good looks, and help him finally accomplish his life goal of collecting all the snuggles he’s been trying to obtain. And trust us....he’s been practicing. Scout is ready to find his people — preferably ones with open arms and a good sense of humor.

desc: Meet Tamryn - a 7-month old sweetheart who her foster affectionately calls her Annie. Tamryn is an affectionate, gentle girl who loves being close to her people and her foster brother Obie. She gives the sweetest kisses and even has the classic...
full: Meet Tamryn - a 7-month old sweetheart who her foster affectionately calls her Annie. Tamryn is an affectionate, gentle girl who loves being close to her people and her foster brother Obie. She gives the sweetest kisses and even has the classic “Pyr paw,”, gently reaching out for affection or to let you know she’d like a little more attention. She’s also wonderfully quiet. She rarely barks, even when Obie sounds the alarm, and when she does bark, she settles quickly when asked. Tamryn enjoys her daily walks with Obie and is already quite good on leash with little pulling. She loves the water and happily wades in the small creek near her foster home - enough for some fun without getting too messy. Despite those impressive big paws, Tamryn doesn’t seem to be growing into a giant dog. Maybe she’ll be a little “pocket Pyr,” although at 7 months old she has some growing to do. She really enjoys the company of other dogs. She requires a playful companion in her new home. She lights up and loves to frolic with neighborhood dogs who stop by. Tamryn lives peacefully with a senior cat. Crate training is still a work in progress. Tamryn hasn’t decided the crate is her favorite place yet, although she’ll happily venture inside to retrieve her beloved toys. She loves chew time - marrow bones, pig ears, toys and pretty much every treat she’s tried. She isn’t hugely food motivated, but she has learned that sitting politely is a great way to earn a treat. At night, Tamryn is a dream. When it’s bedtime, the foster closes the door and she settles right onto her own bed. In the evenings, Tamryn is equally content to relax with her fosters while they watch TV, quietly working on one of her chew toys. A daily walk helps make for an especially happy napper and a great night’s sleep. Car rides are getting better, although Tamryn needs some more experience and patience to become a happy traveler. Tamryn is still very much a puppy - silly, sweet and adorably bendy, sometimes seeming more like spaghetti than a dog. Tamryn loves affection, companionship, exploring outside and being part of whatever her foster family is doing. Her foster fell in love with this special girl very quickly, and easy to imagine her bringing the same joy to her forever family. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate, quieter pup who enjoys other animals, daily adventures and plenty of together time, Tamryn may be your girl.

She may need a little extra care, but this special girl has so much love left to give and would love nothing more than a family of her own.

full: Tucker is a quiet boy in a loud world—and that’s exactly why he deserves someone special. He’s strikingly handsome with a face you’ll remember—and a cautious soul who needs someone willing to let him set the pace and celebrate the tiny wins. Tucker is wary of new people, yet he has never shown aggression—his comfort zone just starts out farther away than most. Born around February 2019, Tucker doesn’t lean on other dogs for confidence, so he’d be happiest as your one-and-only in a calm home without kids—think peaceful routines, soft voices, and a human who understands that is a marathon, not a sprint. The cool part? He’s easy to handle on leash, and once you’ve unlocked the secret code (translation: the extra-yummy treats), he’ll eventually take them gently from your hand. He may never turn into a big cuddler, but he's a sweet boy who deserves a forever home that sees value in small moments—a soft glance, a closer step, a treat accepted, a leash walk that feels a little less scary. If you’re patient and steady and you love the idea of being a sweet boy's safe place, Tucker is ready to meet you exactly as he is—quirks included, heart intact, and hoping you’re his forever. ** Tune in to our Facebook page (Great Pyrenees Rescue Society - GPRS) every Sunday at 3pm CT to see our dogs LIVE! You can also find previous episodes on our YouTube channel (@gprspyrs). If you would like a specific dog to be featured on our show, please email us at info@greatpyreneesrescuesociety.org . **
